Facebook Twitter WhatsApp SMS Email Print Copy article link Save Facebook Twitter WhatsApp SMS Email Print Copy article link Save Today is Friday the 13th, so be careful out there, good people of the Keys.Friday the 13th has historically been an unlucky day. The date has long been associated with bad luck, mysterious events and centuries-old superstition.There are three Friday the 13th dates in 2026, which is unusual, in February, March and November.This year, paranoia and fear may be stronger than normal with some people who are believers in the superstition.So watch your back, Jack. Don’t step on a crack. Or walk under a ladder. Or cross paths with a black cat.If you are feeling a strange sense of unease today, it’s a normal feeling on Friday the 13th. Back luck is in the air everywhere.So maybe you should stay home and reduce the risk of unfortunate incidents, and watch a movie at your crib.Maybe the original “Friday the 13th” flick, which scared the daylights out of people when it was released in 1980.You might even binge on the franchise’s 12 slasher films (1980–2009) centered on the masked killer Jason Voorhees, who terrorized camp counselors at Camp Crystal Lake.
